name: public_sample_seasons
sql: SELECT species_code, product_species_code, season, start_date, end_date, wraps_year FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('yebsap-example') ORDER BY season

name: public_sample_spatial_join
sql: SELECT season FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('yebsap-example') AS r JOIN (SELECT ST_Point(-85,45) AS geom) AS site ON ST_Intersects(ST_GeomFromWKB(r.geometry_wkb), site.geom) ORDER BY season

name: public_sample_valid_wgs84
sql: SELECT geometry_crs, count(*), bool_and(ST_IsValid(ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry_wkb))) FROM ducks.main.seasonal_ranges('yebsap-example') GROUP BY geometry_crs

name: public_sample_52_weeks
sql: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT week_date), min(week_date), max(week_date), min(selected_cell_count), max(selected_cell_count) FROM ducks.main.weekly_abundance('yebsap-example', 'POLYGON((-90 41,-82 41,-82 49,-90 49,-90 41))')

name: public_sample_peak
sql: SELECT week_date, round(mean_relative_abundance,6), round(max_relative_abundance,6), selected_cell_count, modeled_cell_count, round(coverage_fraction,6) FROM ducks.main.migration_calendar('yebsap-example', 'POLYGON((-90 41,-82 41,-82 49,-90 49,-90 41))') ORDER BY week_date
